column1: # Batch 4a: scratch (75) - placeholder, boilerplate and bureaucratic names.
# RULE SET HERE AND USED FOR THE REST OF THE BANK: tt (title twist) covers a
# twist on any recognisable borrowed phrase - song, film, proverb, and also the
# stock strings everyone knows by heart (404, Citation Needed, Reply STOP To
# Cancel, This Side Up). The taxonomy says "song/film/proverb"; a Magic 8-Ball
# answer works on a reader exactly the way a song title does, and sorting those
# into "misdirection" would hide the one thing the engine needs to know - that
# the laugh is borrowed and the reader has to recognise the source.
